code-graph-small-edit.note: Each edit waits for its refresh to finish before the next begins; build counts come from the finished build's metadata and diagnostic.

multi-chat-streaming-sequential.note: One chat streams at a time and every chunk of the fixed event script is released only after the previous one is committed, rendered, and quiet. This is the fixture later phases qualify gating counters on.

stress-transcript.note: Each task is awaited to its rendered state with no provider activity. Main-process tab and transcript updates still arrive asynchronously, so event-driven counts vary between runs.

transcript-active-turn-tools.note: Each active-turn size runs in its own clean bracket with no input probes, but the provider executes a turn's tool calls concurrently and main-process chat events reach the renderer asynchronously, so its counts only report.

transcript-streaming-tail.note: Scroll and typing probes overlap a live mock stream whose start latency varies, so its counts only report.

qualifications.note: Six counters-profile runs of the uncommitted phase 02 harness on d7f5d5e359, with E2E builds of that unchanged product source: five dedicated qualification runs (2-6; --no-diagnostics, private mock-server port) and the full counters-profile verdict run. Run 1 was excluded because transcript-streaming-tail timed out waiting for its stream to start, which also happens with the pre-phase harness. Other worktrees' benchmarks shared the host.
